name: cn.dianyinhuoban.szg.mvp.setting.view.SettingActivity
description: The Dianyinhuoban SHENGZHANGUI (DY_SZG) business SDK opens the account settings page. It links to profile, bank-card, authentication, password, and other account options and handles logout.
disableEffect: Disabling it removes the app's settings and account-management entry.
